template_instructions.fixed_before_execution: Replace every missing value using actual source data and an independently calculated two-item meal. Each expected item has food_name/date/meal_type/grams/nutrition(kcal,carbs,protein,fat)/estimated. Do not populate from the agent's results.

ACTUAL_MESSAGE_ID.cold_start: actual boolean or null if unavailable
ACTUAL_MESSAGE_ID.first_load: actual knowledge index load flag if available
ACTUAL_MESSAGE_ID.ack_elapsed_ms: full entrance-to-HTTP-return measurement required for observed Feishu mode

template_instructions.observed_mode: Start business driver before sending the five planned messages in the actual Feishu chat. Add their actual IDs to actual_message_ids_file keyed initial/record/revise/today/knowledge. The driver observes persisted receipts; it does not send the five user messages. The final duplicate is an explicit synthetic replay of the actual original record message key.
template_instructions.synthetic_mode: Set entry_mode=synthetic_webhook and fixed unique message_id for each row. This measures the real webhook/COS/model/send path with synthetic Feishu-shaped input. It never claims actual user-message T_user or platform warmth without separate evidence.
template_instructions.phases: business (archive pre-paused); operator explicitly resumes archive scheduler; archive (wait/read back within 10-minute original commit bound); cleanup (only fixed candidate Bitable rows soft-deleted, no COS chain deletion); report (offline evidence refresh)
template_instructions.auth: FEISHU_VERIFICATION_TOKEN, Tencent COS read credentials, and existing Feishu/Bitable credentials come from the environment; never put secrets into this plan. The candidate webhook must allow the approved caller; no automatic CAM permission expansion is performed.
template_instructions.failures: Every started attempt and failure is retained. Missing warmth/build/semantic evidence keeps release_gate_passed=false. Cold-only categories require one separately planned new warm sample; never relabel an old/replayed receipt as a new warm sample. This five-message driver reports that gap rather than manufacturing a passing sample.
